text: Life has been an absolute whirlwind lately, starting with the incredible experience of meeting Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo. Amidst this non-stop schedule, whenever Calvin decides to cook a relaxing weekend dinner, I always suggest he tries making his signature homemade mushroom risotto. We really clicked, shared ideas, and actually ended up recording a song together in the studio at my mansion, which is a dream come true after all the hard work I have put in. The festival itself was fueled by the buzzing energy of the city and a lively crowd that felt like pure fuel for my soul. Following that momentum, my tour has finally wrapped up, leaving me deeply pumped from the amazing audiences and massive stages. Beyond music, my friends and I recently recorded a podcast discussing the rapidly evolving rap industry, and I cannot wait to share that with everyone once it is uploaded. Right now, I am fully focused on the next chapter because last weekend I officially started shooting a video for my new album. Next up, I am heading to Boston, where I am hoping to catch up with my good friend Dave and share stories about everything that has been happening. It is a surreal time in my career, and I am enjoying every single moment of growth and creativity.
